Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Thrive on a methodical and structured approach to your work

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.

The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note: You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)

Knife work in high-volume pork production

Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield

Following hygiene and safety procedures

Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

Experience with deboning

Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends

Good knife skills

Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant

Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment

Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

Canteen facilities

Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

Help with accomodation near the working place.

Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift

Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.

If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift

32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application

If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Head of International Staffing, Andrei Maierean, at +45 61 63 07 19 or Staffing Consultant, Damian Bukowski, at +45 73 32 37 53 on weekdays between 08:00 and 16:00.

JKS conducts interviews on an ongoing basis, and the positions may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to hearing from you!

For Solar – the leading European sourcing and services company, we are looking for a Solution Specialist with a background in SAP FI.

Want to work with the newest technologies? This is your opportunity! You will join Solar Digital, which consists of over 200 IT and business specialists who collaborate closely with the business to deliver smarter digital solutions. SAP supports Solar’s main business processes, including product life cycle, procure to pay, receive to ship, order to cash, hire to retire, and finance & analytics. Solar has already embarked on its S/4HANA journey and has been live since October 2024.

What will you be part of?

Solar is a listed sourcing and services company that operates within the installation and industry sectors. In addition to offering customers the best products, Solar is committed to creating a more sustainable business and playing an active role in the green transition. Solar strives to help its customers work more efficiently by leveraging digital solutions, strong online platforms, a robust logistics setup, and a wide range of services to simplify the workday. By joining Solar, you will be part of an innovative team working towards a greener and more efficient future.

Job Overview:

As SAP FI – Solution Specialist, you will be integral to enhancing Solar’s SAP S/4HANA environment, mainly focusing on General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Asset Accounting, but also CO elements for profit center and cost center accounting. You will engage in project work, support, and maintenance, all while leveraging the latest technologies to improve business processes and financial operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Participate in the design, configuration, and implementation of General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Asset Accounting processes.

• Play an important role in both project-based work and day-to-day support, ensuring smooth system functionality aligned with business needs.

• Provide continuous support and maintenance of Solar’s SAP FI module, troubleshooting issues and optimizing performance.

• Work with S/4HANA, exploring innovative technologies like Fiori and BTP (Business Technology Platform) to improve efficiency.

• Core Integrity: Focus on maintaining a clean SAP core by utilizing standard best practices and minimizing custom developments.

Qualifications:

• Experience in SAP FI, with a focus on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Asset Accounting.

• Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA and experience working with Fiori.

• Keen interest in leveraging new technologies.

• Ability to balance project responsibilities with ongoing support and maintenance tasks.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams.

• Exposure to SAP Open Text VIM (Vendor Invoice Management) is an advantage but not a requirement.

Why Join Solar?

You will have the chance to work with the latest SAP technologies in a dynamic and innovative environment. Solar’s ongoing digital transformation using SAP S/4HANA as a core component offers a unique opportunity to explore and expand your expertise in SAP’s newest advancements. Solar is a company committed to sustainability and the green transition, where your work will have a tangible impact on both business efficiency and environmental responsibility.

Solar offers you a flexible workplace and opportunities for personal and professional development. Your work location will be either Vejen, Aarhus or Brøndby.

jobs.occupation: Backend Developer, Data Collection and Infrastructure
jobs.description:
What we are building

Someone researching a purchase might start in ChatGPT, compare options in Perplexity, run a Google search, then go back to an AI assistant to decide. The companies being compared have little idea where they show up in that chain or what gets said about them, and very few can measure it today.

We build the infrastructure that measures it. Every platform we track changes under us, and none of them offers a feed, so we collect the data ourselves. The collection is the hard part, and it is most of this job. Three products run on it:

• AccuRanker is the rank tracking and SEO analytics platform. Rankings, competitor movement, keyword research, dashboards, forecasting.

• AccuLLM tracks brand visibility inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overview, and AI Mode.

• AccuSERP is a search data API we sell to other companies in the industry.

On a normal day that means 27 billion rows inserted, 85 million web requests collected, 80 million background jobs run, and 64 million analytical queries served. Eight people build and run all of it.

What you will work on

• The collection and ingestion pipeline behind those numbers, together with the engineers who run it today.

• Add coverage for new search surfaces as they appear, and fix the ones we already cover when they change shape.

• Write and tune queries against very large time series data, across columnar and relational stores.

• Start with scoped changes to existing services, and grow into owning services yourself, from design through deployment to how they behave in production.

What you bring

Must have:

• Solid programming fundamentals. You write clear code and can reason about what it costs at runtime.

• Code of yours running somewhere real. A production system at work, a service you host yourself, or a side project with actual users.

• Comfort in Linux. You can read logs, follow a request through a system, and find out why something is slow.

• Ownership. You take a problem, decide how to attack it, ask when you are stuck, and follow through.

Good to have:

• Distributed systems fundamentals. Queues, workers, backpressure, etc.

• Python and its common frameworks (Django, Celery, pandas/polars). Our stack runs mostly on Python, but it is not a must if the fundamentals are strong.

• ClickHouse or another columnar store.

• The network layer. Connection lifecycle, timeouts and retries, TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.

• Web scraping or browser automation.

• AI agents. Tool and context design, structured output and evals.

• Kafka.

All of it can be learned here.

Who does well here

People who set a high standard for their own work, and who care about performance, reliability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You want to own a feature end to end, from idea to production. The problems we hand you will be scoped at first, and less so over time, and a month after something ships, you are still the one who cares about it.

You move fast when speed is what the problem needs, and you know when stability, safety and maintainability matter more.

This field moves fast right now. We expect you to read, try things, and form your own view of what is worth using, without waiting to be told what is new.

The job is wide. In one week you might tune a database, debug a proxy network, and design an agent.

This role is not for you if you want a narrow technical scope or a large team around you. We are small, the problems change, and you will get real responsibility earlier than most places give it. The senior engineers sit next to you, and asking them is part of the job.

AI at AccuRanker

AI is a big part of the product and of how we build it. AccuLLM sends queries to LLMs all day, customers use our MCP server, and agents and tool design are real engineering problems here.

Being effective with coding agents is becoming a core engineering skill, and it is part of this job. You should be good at giving agents the right context, breaking work into pieces they can execute well, reviewing what they produce, and knowing when to take over yourself. The bar is more high-quality engineering done without outsourcing your understanding and judgment, which is a different thing from using AI a lot.

How we work

• You own services, not tickets. You decide how to solve the problem, make the tradeoffs, and deploy it yourself.

• We ship many times a day. A change can go from idea to production the same day.

• We argue about designs, in writing and in the room. Correctness, cost, and latency are worth arguing about out loud.

• We share what we know and help each other own unfamiliar parts of the system.

What we offer

• Salary set individually on skills and experience.

• Pension, health insurance, flexible working hours, and paid parental leave.

• Hardware of your choosing.

• Office in central Aarhus on Åboulevarden, top floors, panoramic views over the city. The role is on-site, with hybrid options planned for later this year.

• Great lunch.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note to pet@accuranker.com, in Danish or English. A link to something you have built counts for a lot.

We review applications as they come in and hire as soon as we find the right person, so send yours when it is ready.

Questions about the role are welcome. Call our CTO, Peter Emil Tybirk, on +45 61 41 77 41.

jobs.occupation: Student Software Developer with a Passion for APIs, Integrations, and Modern Tech?
jobs.description:
Do you want to gain hands-on experience building scalable cloud solutions that streamline real business processes?

At HR-ON, we’re looking for a student software developer to join our team. You’ll work with modern technologies to create smart integrations between software systems, helping organizations optimize their HR workflows and data flows.

Whether you're more into backend or enjoy working full-stack, this role offers flexibility, learning opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact alongside experienced developers.

Your Role

As a student developer at HR-ON, you’ll be part of the team behind our serverless HR platform. Your tasks could include:

• Assisting in the development and maintenance of REST and GraphQL APIs.

• Supporting integrations with third-party platforms such as payroll, time tracking, or job portals.

• Working with technologies like Node.js, TypeScript, and frontend frameworks (if full-stack).

• Writing and optimizing queries in PostgreSQL and MariaDB.

• Collaborating with designers, developers, and partners to solve real customer problems.

We’ll tailor your responsibilities to your skills and help you grow through mentorship and hands-on experience.

Who Are You?

You are a student in software development, IT, computer science, or a related field, and you:

• Have basic experience or coursework in software development (backend or full-stack).

• Are curious about APIs, system integrations, and improving workflows between platforms.

• Enjoy solving problems and understanding how tech can support real business needs.

• Like working with modern tools and want to learn best practices in cloud-based development.

• Thrive in a flexible, collaborative, and trust-based environment.

Bonus if you’ve explored areas like cloud computing (AWS), Linux scripting, or type-safe code – but it's not required.

What We Offer

• A student job with real tasks, guidance, and learning opportunities.

• Flexible hours to suit your academic schedule (10–15 hours/week).

• A creative team working on real-world API integrations and platform features.

• A flat, self-managed organization where your input matters.

• A cozy office in central Odense, plus options for hybrid work.

About HR-ON

HR-ON builds modern cloud-based software for recruitment and HR management. From our headquarters in Odense, we serve customers in Denmark, Germany, Norway, and Japan. We’re a team of 50+ people working in tech, support, design, communication, and strategy.

We believe in freedom, trust, and collaboration over rigid hierarchies. If you're looking for a meaningful student job where you can grow your skills and be part of something bigger – you might be a great fit.

Apply Now

We review applications continuously. Send us a brief application and, if possible, link to projects or a GitHub profile.

📞 Questions?

Contact CEO Ali E. Cevik at +45 71 99 07 65 / ali.cevik@hr-on.com

or Lead Tech Strategist Rune Veerasawmy at +45 48 88 30 63 / rune.veerasawmy@hr-on.com

We’re excited to hear from you!

Application deadline : As soon as possible

Do you want to help improve the future of procurement with technology and insight as the driving force?

KPMG is seeking an engaged and detail-oriented consultant for our Sourcing & Procurement consulting area. You will be part of a motivated team that helps some of Denmark's most exciting companies transform their procurement functions.

At KPMG, we help clients redefine procurement through AI, advanced analytics, automation, and sustainable sourcing strategies. We believe the future procurement function will be increasingly data-driven, technology-enabled, and focused on delivering measurable business value. As a consultant, you will help shape that future.

What you will be doing

As a consultant in our team, you will strategically advise clients to optimize their operating model through external suppliers and partnerships. You will be involved in the entire sourcing process, from analysis and strategy to implementation and governance, contributing to impactful projects across both private and public organizations.

Working closely with clients and colleagues, you will help design and deliver solutions that improve procurement performance and support strategic objectives. You will play a key role in translating data and technology into actionable insights while becoming part of an environment where professionalism, innovation, and collaboration go hand in hand.

In practice, that means:

• Contribute to the analysis and development of sourcing strategies and outsourcing models.

• Prepare business cases, supplier analyses, and risk assessments.

• Support the design and implementation of sourcing projects, including transition and governance.

• Facilitate workshops and stakeholder dialogues with clients and suppliers.

• Contribute to proposal writing and business development in sourcing and outsourcing.

• Collaborate with colleagues and experts in KPMG’s global network.

• Assess and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and digital technologies across sourcing and procurement processes.

• Support clients in developing future-fit operating models that combine supplier management, technology enablement, and data-driven decision making.

• Apply analytics and emerging AI tools to improve spend transparency, sourcing insights, and procurement performance.

What we are looking for

• Relevant higher education (e.g., Master's in Business Administration, Master's in Engineering, Master's in Political Science).

• 1–3 years of experience in management consulting, preferably in sourcing, outsourcing, or supplier management.

• Experience with analytical tools and sourcing frameworks.

• Solid analytical skills and good business acumen.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally – both in writing and verbally.

• Fluent in Danish and English – both spoken and written.

• Experience with analytical tools, procurement technologies, or data-driven sourcing methodologies. Curiosity about emerging technologies such as AI, automation, and advanced analytics and their application within procurement and sourcing.

Why join us?

Procurement is changing rapidly. Organizations are increasingly looking to AI, automation, and digital solutions to improve supplier collaboration, improve decision-making, and create greater value. You will help clients navigate this transformation while building knowledge at the intersection of sourcing, technology, and business strategy.

Apply now

We are interested in hearing from you, so please feel free to contact Partner, Peder Hjersing at phjersing@kpmg.com if you have any questions or would like to hear more.

We accept applications and interview candidates on a rolling basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talent at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG.

Would you like to contribute to the future of sourcing and Lead Procurement Transformation in the Age of AI

KPMG is seeking a motivated and strategic manager for our Sourcing & Procurement consulting area. You will be a key person in further developing and leading a skilled team that helps some of Denmark's most forward-thinking companies transform their procurement functions.

At KPMG, we help organizations redesign their procurement and sourcing functions for a rapidly changing world. By combining procurement excellence, AI, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and operating model transformation, we help clients unlock new value, improve decision-making, and build future-ready organizations. As a manager, you will work at the intersection of sourcing, procurement, technology, and business transformation, helping clients navigate both strategic and technological change. You will be responsible for both client projects and business development, becoming a central driving force in translating data into tangible results for our clients.

You will help shape solutions that not only optimize procurement but also redefine how procurement creates value in a modern and complex business environment.

What you will be doing

As a manager our team, you will play a central role in both project delivery and business development. You will manage strategic procurement projects while also contributing to the development of KPMG's market position in sourcing and procurement. The role combines deep professional knowledge and commercial understanding and requires the ability to build good working relationships - both internally and externally.

Beyond traditional sourcing and procurement projects, you will advise clients on how emerging technologies, AI, automation, and digital platforms can reshape procurement operating models, supplier ecosystems, and workforce capabilities. You will help clients identify where technology creates value and translate innovation into practical business outcomes.

In practice, that means:

• Advise clients on sourcing strategies, sourcing models, supplier selection and supplier management.

• Advise clients on the adoption of emerging technologies across sourcing, supplier management, and procurement functions.

• Manage end-to-end sourcing projects – from analysis and business case development to operations and contract management.

• Develop and implement sourcing strategies, including spend analyses, sourcing initiatives, and contract management.

• Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve business performance.

• Develop and execute go-to-market initiatives in the relevant areas.

• Build and maintain relationships with existing and potential clients.

• Contribute to thought leadership and market development within procurement transformation, AI, and digital innovation.

• Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagement across organizations.

• Coach and develop junior consultants within the team.

What we are looking for

• Relevant higher education (e.g., Master's in Business Administration, Master's in Engineering).

• Minimum 6-12 years of experience in sourcing and procurement – preferably from the consulting industry or larger companies.

• Demonstrated experience in business development, customer engagement, and sales activities.

• Solid experience with strategic sourcing, sourcing models, and supplier selection, contract management, and supplier management.

• Experience working with digital transformation, procurement technology, analytics, or AI-enabled business initiatives.

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with technology-enabled problem solving.

• Solid analytical skills and good business acumen.

• Keen interest in how Generative AI and emerging technologies can create business value.

• Fluent in Danish and English – both spoken and written.

Why join us?

The future of procurement is being redefined by AI, intelligent automation, data-driven decision making, and new operating models. Organizations are looking for advisors who can bridge business strategy, technology, and execution. At KPMG, you will work with leading organizations on their most important transformation agendas while helping build the next generation of sourcing and procurement capabilities.

Apply now

We are interested in hearing from you, so please feel free to contact Partner, Peder Hjersing at phjersing@kpmg.com if you have any questions or would like to hear more.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talent at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG.

At Körber Supply Chain DK, we design and deliver advanced automated material handling solutions to customers worldwide. As our business continues to grow across Europe and North America, we are strengthening our capabilities within machine safety and compliance and are looking for an experienced Senior Safety & Compliance Engineer.

This newly established position offers significant influence across the organization. You will become our internal subject matter expert within machine safety and compliance, ensuring that safety requirements are effectively integrated into projects and business processes.

Your Role:

As Senior Safety & Compliance Engineer, you will be responsible for driving machine safety and compliance activities throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and design to commissioning and customer acceptance.

You will work closely with Engineering, Project Management, Commissioning, Service teams, customers, and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and industry standards.

Key responsibilities include:

•    Conducting risk assessments and hazard analyses

•    Developing safety concepts and Safety Requirement Specifications (SRS)

•    Supporting design reviews, FATs, SATs, commissioning, and customer acceptance

•    Ensuring compliance with European and international standards

•    Driving continuous improvement initiatives within machine safety and compliance

•    Acting as the go-to expert for safety-related questions across the organization

The position includes approximately 15-20 travel days per year, primarily related to customer meetings, project activities, factory and site acceptance testing, and commissioning support.

Professional Competencies

We expect you to have solid experience within:

•    CE marking and conformity assessment of machinery and automated systems

•    Risk assessments according to EN ISO 12100

•    Functional safety according to EN ISO 13849 and IEC 62061

•    Development of Safety Requirement Specifications (SRS)

•    Validation and verification of safety-related control systems

•    Safety PLC solutions and safety architectures

•    Technical documentation, declarations of conformity, and technical files

•    Machine safety for automation, robotics, and material handling equipment

•    Machinery lifecycle compliance requirements

Experience with TÜV Functional Safety Engineer, TÜV Machinery Safety Expert, CMSE, or similar certifications is considered an advantage.

Knowledge of the EU Machinery Regulation (EU 2023/1230), IEC 62443, and related machine safety or automation certifications is highly valued. As an increasing number of our projects are delivered to North America, experience with U.S. regulations and standards is highly desirable, including OSHA requirements, NFPA 79, ANSI B11 standards, UL standards and certified components, North American approval, documentation, and customer acceptance processes. Experience working with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) is also an advantage.

Your Profile

You hold a degree in Engineering, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with at least 5-10 years of experience within machine safety, functional safety, or compliance engineering.

You combine strong technical expertise with the credibility and confidence to influence decisions across a complex project organization. You are comfortable challenging solutions when safety requirements are at stake and thrive in a role where you can take ownership, drive initiatives, and lead through expertise.

You are proactive, analytical, and self-driven, with strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across all levels of the organization. Most importantly, you understand how to balance compliance requirements with practical business needs while maintaining a strong customer focus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Backend Developer, Product and Data
jobs.description:
What we are building

Someone researching a purchase might start in ChatGPT, compare options in Perplexity, run a Google search, then go back to an AI assistant to decide. The companies being compared have little idea where they show up in that chain or what gets said about them, and very few can measure it today.

We build the infrastructure that measures it. Every platform we track changes under us, and none of them offers a feed, so we collect the data ourselves. Three products run on it:

• AccuRanker is the rank tracking and SEO analytics platform. Rankings, competitor movement, keyword research, dashboards, forecasting.

• AccuLLM tracks brand visibility inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overview, and AI Mode.

• AccuSERP is a search data API we sell to other companies in the industry. On a normal day that means 27 billion rows inserted, 85 million web requests collected, 80 million background jobs run, and 64 million analytical queries served. Eight people build and run all of it.

This job is on the product side: the backend, the data models, and the query paths that run on top of what we collect.

What you will work on

• Build features across AccuRanker and AccuLLM: Django APIs, background jobs, and the data models behind them.

• Design ClickHouse schemas and query paths, and keep the 64 million daily analytical queries fast as the data grows.

• Work across Postgres and ClickHouse, and decide what lives where.

• Own services end to end, from design through deployment to how they behave in production.

• Take features into the React frontend if you want to. Fullstack is welcome, not required.

What you bring

Must have:

• Python and a major web framework (we run Django and Celery), or equivalent depth in another stack.

• Database and API design. Schemas, indexes, migrations, and APIs that hold up under load.

• Comfort in Linux and close to production. Debugging incidents, understanding system behavior, improving observability, making services more reliable.

• Ownership and initiative. You take a problem, you decide how to solve it, and you follow through.

Good to have:

• React and TypeScript, for the optional frontend part of the job.

• ClickHouse or another columnar store at scale.

• Kafka.

• AI agents in production. Tool and context design, structured output and evals.

• Data infrastructure at scale. The ingestion, storage, and query-performance problems our numbers imply.

Who does well here

People who set a high standard for their own work, and who care about performance, reliability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You own a feature end to end, from idea to production. You can make progress while the problem is still half defined, and a month after it ships, you are still the one who cares about it.

You move fast when speed is what the problem needs, and you know when stability, safety, and maintainability matter more.

This field moves fast right now. We expect you to read, try things, and form your own view of what is worth using, without waiting to be told what is new.

The job is wide. In one week you might tune a query, ship a customer-facing feature, and design an agent.

This role is not for you if you want a roadmap handed to you, a narrow technical scope, or a large team around you. We are small, the problems change, and you will often be the person deciding both what to build and what “done” means.

AI at AccuRanker

AI is a big part of the product and of how we build it. AccuLLM sends queries to LLMs all day, customers use our MCP server, and agents and tool design are real engineering problems here.

Being effective with coding agents is becoming a core engineering skill, and it is part of this job. You should be good at giving agents the right context, breaking work into pieces they can execute well, reviewing what they produce, and knowing when to take over yourself. The bar is more high-quality engineering done without outsourcing your understanding and judgment, which is a different thing from using AI a lot.

How we work

• You own services, not tickets. You decide how to solve the problem, make the tradeoffs, and deploy it yourself.

• We ship many times a day. A change can go from idea to production the same day.

• We argue about designs, in writing and in the room. Correctness, cost, and latency are worth arguing about out loud.

• We share what we know and help each other own unfamiliar parts of the system.

What we offer

• Salary set individually on skills and experience.

• Pension, health insurance, flexible working hours, and paid parental leave.

• Hardware of your choosing.

• Office in central Aarhus on Åboulevarden, top floors, panoramic views over the city. The role is on-site, with hybrid options planned for later this year.

• Great lunch.

We review applications as they come in and hire as soon as we find the right person, so send yours when it is ready.
